manifest.name: dsh-web-fetch-fix
manifest.description: Drop-in replacement for @deepseek-ai/dsh-web-fetch-http that removes the public-IP (SSRF) gate, so web_fetch works behind a local VPN/TUN fake-ip resolver (Clash etc.).
manifest.author: zhuweiyou <i@zhuweiyou.com> (https://github.com/zhuweiyou)

bundle.text:
# dsh-web-fetch-fix — bundle patch layer (one bundle, can ship many patched web packages).
#
# Each patched package lives in its own `web-*` directory and is built to
# `web-*/lib/index.js`; see scripts/build.mjs. Each one is registered with its
# own `- insert` row whose `name` is the package subpath, e.g.
# `dsh-web-fetch-fix/web-fetch-http` (resolved through package.json exports "./web-*").
#
# ---- web-fetch-http -------------------------------------------------------
# Drop-in copy of official @deepseek-ai/dsh-web-fetch-http (tag dsh-v0.2.1-rc.3)
# with only the public-IP (SSRF) gate removed — that gate rejects reserved
# addresses like 198.18.0.0/15 which a local Clash/VPN TUN in fake-ip mode hands
# out for perfectly public hostnames.

# IMPORTANT: keep exactly ONE `- id: web` patch. An id-targeted patch replaces the
# whole entry config, so all provider selections must be stated together here;
# two separate `- id: web` patches would clobber each other. When you add another
# patched web package that needs a different web.* provider, add its field here.
- id: web
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-web'
  config:
    searchProvider: deepseek-official
    fetchProvider: web-fetch-fix

# Register the patched fetch provider (provider id `web-fetch-fix`, see
# web-fetch-http/src/provider.ts). Add further packages as further insert rows.
- insert:
    - id: web-fetch-fix
      name: dsh-web-fetch-fix/web-fetch-http

readme.text: 修复 DSH `web_fetch`：在开了 VPN/TUN（如 Clash fake-ip）的机器上，抓取公网网页会被误判成内网地址而拒绝。

开着 TUN/fake-ip 时，`web_fetch` 抓网页会报：

```
Error: URL hostname "xxx" resolves to a non-public IP address
```

装上本插件后即可正常抓取，工具名、参数、其它行为都不变。

Clash 等 TUN 的 fake-ip 会把**公网域名**解析成保留段地址（如 `198.18.0.53`），但 TUN 会把发往这个地址的连接透明路由到真实目标——所以它其实不是内网。官方抓取器 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-fetch-http` 里有一段“不是公网 unicast 就拒绝”的 SSRF 判定，把它挡掉了。

因此做法就是：**把官方 `web-fetch-http` 源码原样复制过来，只删掉这段判定**，其余（URL 校验、重定向、解压、charset、大小/超时限制等）完全不动。
`npm install && npm run build`（esbuild 自动发现所有 `web-*/src/index.ts`，逐个生成 `web-*/lib/index.js`，DSH 加载的就是这些 JS）。

一个仓库 = 一个 bundle，可包含多个被修补的包：每个 `web-*` 目录是一个官方 `packages/web/*` 的原样副本（只改必要几行），产物是 `web-*/lib/index.js`；`package.json` 用 `exports: { "./web-*": "./web-*/lib/index.js" }` 暴露子路径，`cordis.patch.yml` 里每个包一行 `insert`。

**以后再加一个 web 包，只有两步：**
1. 把官方 `packages/web/<name>` 原样复制成 `<name>/`，做你那几行改动；
2. 在 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `insert` 里加一行：
   ```yaml
   - id: <行 id>
     name: dsh-web-fetch-fix/<name>
   ```
   若该包需要改 `web.*` 的选型（如 searchProvider），把字段并入**同一个** `- id: web` 的 config（不要新开第二个 `- id: web`，会被整体覆盖）。
   之后 `npm run build` 即可，`package.json` 不用改。
